AI Agent Developer · LLM Researcher

AI Agent Developer at CodePresso
Research Assistant at NLP & KD Lab, Ton Duc Thang University

I am an AI Agent Developer at CodePresso and a Research Assistant at the Natural Language Processing & Knowledge Discovery Lab, Ton Duc Thang University.

My research focuses on large language models: retrieval-augmented generation for legal documents, domain-specific fine-tuning, and synthetic data for low-resource tasks. At work I build LLM-based agents for automatic assessment content generation, code scoring, and code-interview analysis.

Large Language Models · Retrieval-Augmented Generation · Parameter-efficient fine-tuning · Synthetic data · AI Agents
